entries.title: Mini not printing: Diagnostics, update and restart
steps: On the home screen tap Diagnostics to view the printer status and queue.
Check the printer settings in the device menu.
Make sure the latest update is installed.
Power the device off, wait a few minutes, and power it back on.
entries.quote: Power off the device, wait a few minutes, and power it back on.

entries.title: Print a test receipt on a Mini
steps: Tap the Printers app.
Select your printer.
Tap the Print test receipt button.
entries.quote: Tap the Print test receipt button.

entries.title: Mini 3 cannot be tethered to a Station 2
steps: A Mini 3 cannot be connected to a Station 2.
entries.quote: Note: Mini 3 cannot be connected to Station 2.

entries.title: Orders are not printing on the kitchen printer: check labels
steps: Orders only print to the kitchen printer when the correct labels are assigned.
Open the Printers app.
Find the printer under Order printers and select it.
Under Labels to auto-print, make sure Kitchen is selected (and any other labels you use).
entries.quote: Orders will not print to your kitchen printer unless the correct labels are assigned.

entries.title: Station does not detect the kitchen printer, or it is offline
steps: Make sure Ethernet is enabled under Settings on the Station.
Trace the Ethernet cord from the Station to the router.
If the Station stays offline, replace the cables with new ones.
entries.quote: If your Station is not detecting the kitchen printer (KP) or it is not online, make sure Ethernet is enabled under Settings.

entries.title: Kitchen printer: paper roll direction
steps: Make sure the paper roll feeds from the bottom, not from the top.
entries.quote: Make sure the paper roll feeds from the bottom, not from the top.

entries.title: Kitchen printer: power light blinks green and orange, error light blinks red
steps: The paper roll may be jammed or missing.
Clear the jam or load a paper roll.
entries.quote: If the power light blinks green and orange and the error light blinks red, the paper roll may be jammed or missing.

entries.title: Kitchen printer: power light orange, error light red
steps: The paper lid is open.
Close the paper lid until it snaps shut.
entries.quote: If the power light is orange and the error light is red, close the paper lid until it snaps shut.

entries.title: Kitchen printer: power light blinks red and orange, error light blinks red
steps: The cartridge lid is open.
Close the cartridge lid until it snaps shut.
entries.quote: If the power light blinks red and orange and the error light blinks red, close the cartridge lid until it snaps shut.

entries.title: Kitchen printer offline: check the router and Wi-Fi
steps: Check the router lights show it is connected to the internet; if it cannot connect, contact your internet provider.
If the Clover device has a spotty connection or is offline, make sure its Wi-Fi is connected and on the correct network.
entries.quote: If the Clover device has a spotty connection or is offline, ensure the WiFi is connected, and the device is on the correct network.

entries.title: Kitchen printer's IP address is not found in the Printers app
steps: Turn the kitchen printer off.
Hold the feed button and turn it back on until it prints a diagnostic.
Try plugging the printer into a different port on the router.
If it still fails, contact support.
entries.quote: turn off the kitchen printer (KP), then hold the feed button and turn it back on until it prints a diagnostic

entries.title: Connect a Star SP742M / SP742ME kitchen printer
steps: You need a power source, a modem, a router, and a Cat5 Ethernet cable from printer to router.
Flip the printer over to see the sockets.
Plug the Ethernet cable into the printer and the router. The Clover device must be on the same router, directly or by Wi-Fi.
Plug the power cable into the printer, turn it upright, and plug into power.
Flip the switch on the side of the printer to ON.
Red and yellow lights blink slowly; a single green light under the power label means the printer is talking to the network.
Then bring the printer online in the Printers app.
entries.quote: When a single green light turns on under the power label and icon, your order printer is communicating with the network.

entries.title: Load paper in a Star SP742M / SP742ME kitchen printer
steps: Make sure the printer is off.
Open the paper compartment and pull down the switch to the right of the paper cutter.
Insert the roll so the end comes toward the front along the bottom of the compartment.
Pull out about an inch of paper and close the cover.
The power light should glow green and the Error light should be off.
Use 1-ply, 3-inch x 165 foot rolls (76mm, roll diameter up to 85mm).
entries.quote: The power light should glow green and the Error light should be off.

entries.title: Which Clover devices can send orders to a network kitchen printer, and how
steps: Station and Mini models can use Ethernet or Wi-Fi to send orders for printing.
Flex uses Wi-Fi only.
The printer and the Clover device must be on the same router.
entries.quote: These Clover devices use Wi-Fi (only) to send orders for printing: Mobile, Flex.

entries.title: Connect a Star TSP143III receipt or order printer
steps: Plug the Ethernet cable into the printer and the router. The Clover device must be on the same router, directly or by Wi-Fi.
Plug the power cable into the printer and into power.
Switch the power on, on the left side of the printer.
Open the paper compartment and drop in the roll so the end comes along the bottom toward the front.
Pull out about an inch of paper and close the cover.
Then bring the printer online in the Printers app.
entries.quote: On the left side of the printer, switch the power on.

entries.title: Where a Star TSP143III thermal printer works best
steps: It is a quiet thermal printer that works best in areas with normal heat and humidity.
It can be used as an order printer, a payment receipt printer, or both.
For hot, humid kitchens Clover offers the Star SP742 impact printer instead.
entries.quote: This thermal printer is built to print quietly, and works best in areas with normal amounts of heat and humidity.

entries.title: Add (bring online) a receipt printer
steps: An external printer must be plugged in and on the same network as your Clover system.
On the Clover device, open the Printers app.
Select Add at the lower right.
Select Receipt Printer.
Select the printer by name from the list; it comes online and joins the online printers list.
Repeat for each further printer.
entries.quote: From the list of connected printers, select the printer by name.

entries.title: Take a receipt printer offline for a while
steps: Go to the printer itself and switch it off.
entries.quote: Go directly to the printer and switch it off.

entries.title: Rename an external printer
steps: On the device tap Printers.
Tap the printer to rename.
Under Printer Name, enter the new name.
Tap Save.
entries.quote: Under Printer Name, enter the new name.

entries.title: Built-in Clover printers cannot be renamed
steps: Printers that come with a Station, Mini or Flex are embedded (local) printers and cannot be renamed.
entries.quote: Printers that come with a Clover Station, Mini, or Flex are referred to as embedded or local printers and cannot be renamed.

entries.title: Receipt printer is not listed under Payment receipts
steps: Open the Setup app and select Payment receipts; the top of the screen shows whether your receipt printer is added.
If it is not listed: plug it in, connect it to your Clover network, open the Printers app, select Add, then Receipt printer.
entries.quote: If it is not listed, plug it in, connect it to your Clover network, open the Printers app, select Add, and then select Receipt printer.

entries.title: Make receipts print automatically after each order
steps: Open the Setup app.
Select Payment receipts.
Select 'Automatically print customer receipt after each order'.
Optionally select Skip receipt screen to go straight to the next transaction.
entries.quote: Automatically print customer receipt after each order: Select this option to print receipts automatically.

entries.title: Receipt logo uses extra paper
steps: Showing your business logo on receipts uses extra paper.
Change it under Setup > Payment receipts > Receipt logo.
entries.quote: Receipt logo: Shows your business logo on all payment receipts. This does use extra paper, so keep that in mind.

entries.title: Paper size: Station printer
steps: 3 1/8 inches wide x 230 feet long (80 mm x 70 m) thermal paper.
entries.quote: Station printer: 3 ⅛ inches wide × 230 feet long (80 mm × 70 m) thermal paper

entries.title: Paper size: Compact, Mini and Flex
steps: 2 1/4 inches wide x 85 feet long (57 mm x 25.9 m) thermal paper.
entries.quote: Clover Compact, Mini, and Flex internal printers: 2 ¼ inches wide × 85 feet long (57 mm × 25.9 m) thermal paper

entries.title: Paper size: Kiosk
steps: 3 1/8 inches wide x 230 feet long (80 mm x 70 m) thermal paper.
entries.quote: Kiosk: 3 ⅛ inches wide × 230 feet long (80 mm × 70 m) thermal paper

entries.title: Paper size: Star SP742 kitchen printer
steps: 3 inches wide x 165 feet long (76 mm x 50 m) impact (non-thermal) paper, roll diameter 85 mm at most.
entries.quote: Star Micronics SP742 kitchen printer (impact printer): 3 inches wide × 165 feet long (76 mm × 50 m) impact (non‑thermal) paper, with a maximum roll diameter of 85 mm

entries.title: Order receipt paper from the device
steps: Install the Order paper app from the App market on the device if it is not there.
Open the Order paper app.
Select your printer and the number of rolls.
Review and tap Place order.
Paper cannot be ordered from the dashboard.
entries.quote: Review the order and tap Place order.

entries.title: Can I use receipt paper from an office supply store?
steps: Yes. Compatible thermal receipt paper from most office supply retailers works.
Make sure the size and type match your device.
entries.quote: You can purchase compatible thermal receipt paper from most office supply retailers.

entries.title: Track a device you have ordered
steps: Log in to the Clover dashboard.
Select Settings > View all settings.
In Business operations, select Devices and printers.
On the Devices tab find the device.
Select the Track Order link next to its status.
entries.quote: Select the Track Order link next to the device status to view real-time shipping updates.

entries.title: Device order status: Delivered
steps: The activation code is displayed after the device is delivered.
Use it to activate the device.
entries.quote: Delivered Activation Code displayed Displays after your device is delivered; use it to activate your device.

entries.title: Device order status: Shipping Error, Shipping Cancelled, or Return to Sender
steps: Use the Track Order link to see the shipment details.
These statuses may need support to resolve.
entries.quote: Some statuses, such as Shipping Error, Shipping Cancelled, or Return to Sender, may require you to contact Clover support for resolution.

entries.title: Cash drawer doesn't open: open it from the Register app
steps: The drawer must be connected to your Clover device.
Open the Register app.
At the top right select Options > Open Cash Drawer.
Choose whether you are removing or adding cash and enter the amount.
Enter a reason; it appears in the Cash Log.
Tap Continue.
entries.quote: When the cash drawer door doesn't open, you can use the Register app to open it if it is connected to your Clover device.

entries.title: Allow employees to open the cash drawer
steps: Log in to the Clover dashboard.
Select Employees, then Options > Permissions.
Go to Access Register and select View App Permissions.
Select the Edit icon next to Open cash drawer manually and choose the roles allowed.
Select Save.
entries.quote: Select the Edit icon next to Open cash drawer manually and change the roles that are permitted to open the drawer.

entries.title: Cash drawer does not open for a payment type
steps: Each tender type has an Opens cash drawer checkbox.
When it is cleared, the drawer does not open for that tender; tick it and tap Save.
entries.quote: When the checkbox is cleared, the cash drawer does not open.

entries.title: Flex does not open the cash drawer automatically
steps: Clover Flex devices do not automatically open the cash drawer.
entries.quote: Note: Clover Flex and Mobile devices do not automatically open the cash drawer.

entries.title: Plan counter space and power for a countertop Clover
steps: Make space on the counter for a Mini, Station Solo or Station Duo.
You may need an extension cord or power strip if the outlet is more than 6 feet from the device.
Allow room for accessories such as scales, printers and cash drawers.
entries.quote: You may need an extension cord or power strip if the nearest outlet is more than 6 feet (1.8288 meters) from the device.

entries.title: First power-on of any Clover device
steps: Connect the power cord as the Quick Start Guide shows.
Press the power button until the Clover logo appears.
Choose your language and review the internet connection status.
Enter the activation code when asked; Clover then installs the latest apps.
entries.quote: Press the power button until the Clover logo appears. Choose your language and review your internet connection status.

entries.title: Unlock the device with a fingerprint instead of a passcode
steps: Works on Clover devices with fingerprint sensors.
Open the Employees app and select the employee.
Select Edit, then Add a Fingerprint.
Have the employee press and release a fingertip on the sensor, following the on-screen hints.
Save.
entries.quote: Clover devices with fingerprint sensors can be set to unlock with a fingerprint instead of a passcode.

entries.title: Unlock the device with an employee card
steps: Employee cards are ordered by calling Clover Support.
Open the Employees app and select the employee.
Select Edit, then Add an Employee Card.
Swipe the card in the card reader.
Save.
entries.quote: Employee cards provide a way for you and your employees to unlock your Clover device without a passcode.

entries.title: Device logs out after every sale (or should)
steps: On the device open the Setup app and select Payments.
Tick or clear 'Log out after each order'.
entries.quote: Select the Log out after each order checkbox.

entries.title: Clover Go reader: three setup steps from the Quick Start Guide
steps: Connect the reader to power to charge it (an adapter may be needed).
Get the Clover Go app from clover.com/app-download.
Pair the reader with your phone or tablet using the Clover Go app.
entries.quote: with your phone or tablet
entries.note: Quote is a fragment of the picture-based guide: "Pair the reader with your phone or tablet using the Clover Go app".

entries.title: Clover Go reader status lights
steps: The lights show battery, pairing and payment status: charging, fully charged, ready to pair, paired, insert or tap card, and critically low battery.
The printed guide shows the light patterns as pictures.
To save battery, the lights may not appear.
entries.quote: To conserve battery, status
entries.note: The guide shows the light colours only as images; they are not in the extracted text.

entries.title: When the Go reader is ready to pair or take payments
steps: When charging, or powered on and fully charged, the reader is ready to pair or take payments.
entries.quote: and fully charged, the reader is

entries.title: Kitchen Display mounting screws and VESA pattern
steps: The display uses a 100mm VESA pattern with four M4 - 0.7 screws.
Screws must be 14mm long at most.
The stand is not included; attach the screen using the instructions that came with your stand.
entries.quote: 14mm screw maximum length

entries.title: Kitchen Display: remove the waterproof caps before plugging in
steps: Remove the waterproof caps first, before connecting cables.
Plug into a grounded AC outlet last.
entries.quote: Remove waterproof caps first.

entries.title: Kitchen Display Power over Ethernet port
steps: On PoE-enabled networks the Power Over Ethernet port (IEEE 802.3at, PoE+) can power the display instead of the adapter.
Connect the KDS only to PoE networks without routing to the outside plant.
entries.quote: The Clover KDS should be connected only to PoE networks without routing to the outside plant.

entries.title: Kiosk: plug into power last
steps: Connect everything else first.
Plug in last, to a grounded AC power outlet.
The guide also shows in pictures how to install printer paper (roll 80 mm / 3.125 in wide).
entries.quote: How to install printer paper

entries.title: Station Duo: turning it on
steps: Connect the power cord to a grounded AC outlet.
Press the power button until the Clover logo appears.
entries.quote: Press power button until Clover logo appears.

entries.title: Station Solo: plug into power last
steps: Connect the parts in the order pictured.
Plug in last, to a grounded AC power outlet.
A Flex and its charging cable accessory are sold separately.
entries.quote: Flex and charging cable accessory sold separately.

entries.title: Flex charging cradle safety rules
steps: Store in a dry place and clean with a dry cloth.
Do not take apart or modify the device.
While charging, do not put any metal object between the charging area on the cradle and the Flex.
Do not charge anything else on the cradle; it is made only for the Clover Flex.
entries.quote: Do not charge any device other than the Clover Flex.

entries.title: Compact: optional PIN shield and mounting
steps: The guide shows three steps in pictures: install the printer roll, optionally install the PIN shield, then power on.
Plug in last, to a grounded AC power outlet.
Mounting option: metric thread M6 x 1, depth 8mm (5/16 in).
entries.quote: Optional: Install PIN shield

entries.title: What's in the Clover cash drawer box
steps: Cash drawer, bill tray, coin tray, two keys, and an RJ-11 6P6C cable.
Clover Station and Mini devices connect to the drawer with that cable.
entries.quote: You can connect Clover Station and Mini devices to the drawer with the RJ-11 6P6C cable.

entries.title: Connect the cash drawer to a Station printer
steps: Insert the cable end with the blue sticker and cash icon into the bottom of the drawer.
Insert the other end, with the blue sticker and printer icon, into the Clover Station Printer's port marked with the blue cable image.
To keep track of transactions, connect both your Clover device and your cash drawer to the same router.
entries.quote: Insert one end of the RJ-11 6P6C cable (with blue sticker and cash icon) into the bottom of the drawer.

entries.title: Test the cash drawer connection
steps: Insert the drawer key and turn it all the way to the left to unlock and open the drawer.
Close the drawer, leaving it unlocked with the key vertical, and pull the key out.
Open the Register app and tap Open Cash Drawer.
Tap Other, enter Test next to Reason for Opening, and tap Continue.
The drawer should open.
entries.quote: Close the drawer, leaving it unlocked, with the key in the vertical position.

entries.title: No Open Cash Drawer button in the Register app
steps: Your employee profile may not have permission to open the drawer.
Set the permission up in the Employees app.
entries.quote: Your employee profile might not give you permission to open the drawer.

entries.title: Lock the cash drawer
steps: Insert the drawer key.
Twist it all the way to the right, to a horizontal position.
Pull the key out.
Lock the drawer manually after business hours.
entries.quote: Twist the key all the way to the right to a horizontal position.

entries.title: Cash drawer won't open from the Register app: check the key lock
steps: When the drawer is manually locked with the key, it cannot be opened from the Register app.
Unlock it with the key (turned all the way left opens it; leave the key vertical for normal use).
entries.quote: When the cash drawer is manually locked, it cannot be accessed from the Register app.
entries.note: Key positions for unlocking come from the Clover cash drawer setup article.

entries.title: Make the cash drawer open automatically for cash (or other tenders)
steps: On the Clover device open the Setup app.
Tap Payments, then Tenders accepted.
Tap the tender that should open the drawer.
Tick Opens cash drawer and tap Save.
Repeat for each tender type that should open the drawer.
entries.quote: Check the box that Opens cash drawer.

entries.title: Connect an external USB barcode scanner
steps: Plug the scanner USB cable into a USB port on the Hub.
The Station or Mini should recognize it immediately.
Test in the Register app: hold the scanner button, point the light at a barcode; you hear a beep and the Product Code is added.
entries.quote: The barcode scanner should be immediately recognized by the Clover Stations or Mini and will be ready for use.

entries.title: External barcode scanner not working as expected: reset and reprogram
steps: The scanner may need a factory reset and reprogramming, done by scanning special barcodes.
Find your scanner model (Zebra DS9308, DS2208 or DS9208) in Clover's article.
Scan the first barcode to reset the scanner, then the second barcode to reprogram it.
The barcodes themselves are images in the Clover article; ask support for them if needed.
entries.quote: you may need to scan some barcodes to factory-reset and reprogram your scanner
entries.note: The reset barcodes are images and are not in the saved text.
entries.review: routed to support by rule: steps need staff access

entries.title: External barcode scanners that work with Clover Station and Mini
steps: Zebra DS9308 and Zebra/Symbol DS2208 (Clover-customized versions) are recommended.
Zebra/Symbol DS9208 (Clover-customized) is still supported.
Other scanners might work but are not tested by Clover.
entries.quote: Other external barcode scanners might also work. However, we have specifically tested these scanners to ensure they work with Clover devices.

entries.title: Connect a sticky label printer (Epson TM-L90 PLUS)
steps: Plug the supplied USB printer cable into the Clover device hub and the printer power cable into power.
On the Clover device open the Printers app and tap Add.
Tap Label Printer; the system scans for printers.
Select the TM Printer; it connects and shows as online.
Load 2 1/4 in x 1 1/4 in direct thermal labels following the printer maker instructions.
Slide the mode switch at the top left of the printer front to the left for continuous mode.
entries.quote: Select the TM Printer. The printer connects automatically and appears in the list of online printers.

entries.title: Sticky label printer shows offline or is not listed
steps: In the Printers app, tap Sync in the upper-right corner to refresh.
entries.quote: If the printer appears offline or is not listed, tap Sync in the upper-right corner to refresh the system.

entries.title: The two Kitchen Display modes
steps: The KDS has two views: Kitchen mode and Expo mode.
entries.quote: The Clover KDS features two viewing options, Kitchen mode and Expo mode, to suit your back-of-house needs.

entries.title: How to insert a chip card on a Flex
steps: Insert the card chip end first.
Remove it when the device prompts.
Follow the on-screen instructions.
entries.quote: Insert the card with the
entries.note: From the older Flex Starter Kit guide; card handling is the same in principle but check against the current model. Quote is the first line of a multi-line sentence: "Insert the card with the chip end first."

entries.title: How to swipe a card on a Flex
steps: Swipe with the magnetic stripe facing down.
Either direction works: right to left or left to right.
entries.quote: magnetic stripe facing
entries.note: From the older Flex Starter Kit guide; card handling is the same in principle but check against the current model.

entries.title: Best distance for scanning a barcode with a Flex
steps: Point the scanner at the barcode and hold down the barcode trigger.
